source: International Institute for Population Sciences, NFHS-6 (2023-24) state fact sheets: babies breastfed within one hour of birth, as labelled in the fact sheet. Survey estimates; small places swing more. 34 states and UTs; Lakshadweep (small sample) is not ranked and Manipur has no NFHS-6 sheet yet.
